standard.summary: 预留字段，当前版本未实现。开启它不会改变 loss 缩放或梯度行为，只保留配置兼容性。
standard.whenToUse: 暂无。需要混合精度缩放时请使用现有的 AMP GradScaler 或 BF16 精度设置。
standard.avoidWhen: 任何时候都不要依赖它处理梯度溢出或消失，它不会生效。

standard_en.summary: Reserved field, not implemented in this version. Enabling it does not change loss scaling or gradient behaviour; it is kept for config compatibility only.
standard_en.whenToUse: None yet. Use the existing AMP GradScaler or BF16 precision settings when you need mixed-precision scaling.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not rely on it for gradient overflow or vanishing gradients; it does nothing.

advanced.principle: 字段与开关保留以便旧配置继续加载；真实动态缩放仍由 GradScaler 体系负责。

advanced_en.principle: The field and switch stay so old configs keep loading; actual dynamic scaling remains owned by the GradScaler stack.
